_comment: High advisories in production dependencies that have no safe fix yet, reviewed 2026-10-29. xlsx moved to the SheetJS CDN build 0.20.3, sharp and image-size are pinned to fixed versions through package.json overrides. Remove an entry as soon as its fix ships. audit-gate.mjs fails again when a safe fix becomes available.

advisories.reason: Memory exhaustion on oversized constrained collections. @imgly/background-removal lists zod ^3 but ships its own bundled copy of zod in dist/index.mjs, so an override would not change the code that runs; it only validates the app's own small config object, never file data. The fix (zod 4.6.6) is a major bump with a different API (z.function().args is gone). Remove when @imgly moves to zod 4.
